behaviors_covered: All eight researched nominal examples specify every input and assert every output through mod common.
divider_bias: finite-beta loading, independent low-beta vector, KCL, tiny positive near-cutoff current, cutoff/saturation equality and invalid-parameter rejection.
saturated_switch_drive: fractional forced beta, zero driver resistance, exact driver-current capability, tiny positive external resistance, overload/headroom/domain rejection.
hybrid_pi_parameters: exact SI thermal voltage, independently expected current scaling, gm*rpi identity, inclusive 200/450 K endpoints and invalid bias/beta/temperature rejection.
emitter_degeneration_gain: negative gains, source attenuation, independent gm=1 S/low-beta vector, zero source resistance, exact ro validity boundary and all input/model guards.
terminal_dissipation: both terminal powers, reference-voltage-independent conservation, saturation acceptance, base-only/collector-only/all-zero boundaries and negative/nonfinite rejection.
early_output_resistance: full affine Early correction, conductance reciprocity, large approximation error, one-ulp forward-active boundary and active-region/domain rejection.

differential_pair_steering: emitter-to-collector conversion, current conservation, sign swap, zero balance, signed +/-1e-20 V signals retaining approximately 3.83e-22 A differences, inward-rounded +/-40 VT edges retaining tiny branch currents, temperature endpoints and all guards.
emitter_follower_loading: finite-beta input loading, positive subunity gains, exchanged unequal emitter/load resistors, zero source resistance, exact ro boundary and all guards.

verification.review: Static syntax/API consistency review only; independent high-precision numerical derivation, no engine execution.

untested_gaps: Parent must execute the authored integration tests and complete suite.
JSON-lines transport, UI rendering/error recovery and native desktop execution remain parent-owned.
Actual device SOA/compliance, leakage/mismatch, finite-frequency behavior and omitted nonlinear physics are not established by these arithmetic tests.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.scenario: Run all eight explicit nominal vectors and compare every output against the committed tests.
Preserve tiny signed differential-pair imbalance in consecutive positive/negative requests.
Reject saturated divider without emitting a clipped operating point; then recover on the next valid request.
Accept exact driver capacity and zero driver resistance.

parent_desktop_scenarios: Inspect all eight nominal models: every output, SI unit, formula, source and model limitation is visible.
Display negative common-emitter gains as successful signed results and positive subunity follower gains distinctly.
Show exact zero differential imbalance and tiny signed imbalance/current outputs without formatting them into misleading zero.
Trigger divider saturation, driver overload, out-of-envelope temperature and inadequate amplifier ro; clear stale results and recover after correction.
Accept zero terminal currents/voltages and Vce<Vbe terminal-power calculations without incorrectly applying forward-active-only restrictions.
